steps.label: Spawn
steps.note:
Phase 3 here: https://ff14.toolboxgaming.space/?id=463534803605261&preview=1

Ifrit will spawn on a cardinal. Look at him -- The upcoming safespot will then be to your left or right.

steps.label: Center Boss
steps.note:
Boss spawns mid - keep him there to prevent knockback issues with next mechanic.

Ifrit and Titan will always spawn facing south, so generally you will start tanking them that direction to prevent spinning.

steps.label: Hellfire - Knockback
steps.note:
Raidwide + Shield up to mitigate knockback

In order to consistently live & shield Vulcan Burst, make sure to pair up an AoE shielding ability (Aspected Helios/Succor/Shake/Veil) with at least 1 healing cooldown.

steps.label: Tankbuster
steps.note: Triple tankbuster. Invuln, or if gnb/war (8s), mitigate the 1st + Invuln, or double tank swap.

steps.label: Nails Spawn
steps.note:
Nails will spawn in random locations, but always the same formation -- 2 close nails and 2 far nails. 
2 nails are always cardinal and 2 nails are always intercadinal.

steps.label: Positioning
steps.note:
MT will pull Ifrit between the two close nails.

OT will be tethered to a random DPS - try to stay close to them, but focus on nails/ifrit.

The 2 farthest players will be marked for a set of 4 eruptions.

A random healer will receive the Infernal Howl debuff and needs to bait the AOE opposite MT.

steps.label: First 2 Eruptions
steps.note:
Ifrit casts Searing Wind on the marked healer as the first two eruptions go off.

Each nail needs to be hit with at least two eruptions.

steps.label: Last 2 Eruptions + Nail 1
steps.note: The last eruption can hit both nails & overlap as much as necessary.

steps.label: Nail 2
steps.note:
At this point some of the dps should focus on killing nails in the following order.

Everyone else can continue focusing on Ifrit.

steps.label: Stack Mid
steps.note: After nails are destroyed, Ifrit will jump away. Stack mid for raidwide.

steps.label: Hellfire
steps.note: Raidwide

steps.label: Pull to Intercard
steps.note:
Pull ifrit to the intercardinal the LAST nail was killed. If it was on a cardinal, use the first intercardinal clockwise.

Ranged and healers get ready to bait eruptions & Infernal Howl again.

steps.label: First 2 Eruptions
steps.note:
Healer bait on intercard COUNTERclockwise from the party.

DPS bait on CARDINAL clockwise from the party, and move towards the party.

steps.label: Clones
steps.note: Clones will spawn on cardinals.

steps.label: Dash
steps.note: Clones will dash across the arena

steps.label: Flaming Crush
steps.note:
2nd healer move into position for an additional Searing Wind.

One player will receive a marker overhead, and the party will need to stack for a shared cleave.

steps.label: Repositioning
steps.note:
The party will be on the slice the LAST nail was killed, in order to be under the 4th ifrit dash. (4th nail was killed at A in this example)

Healer with second searing wind will mirror the party from the other side of the arena.

Note that with enough dps you can skip dashes entirely. As of 6.0, this is extremely easy to do, especially with a summoner. Otherwise you may need pots to do so.
If you fail to skip, you will have different buff alignment, so whichever you do, be consistent.

steps.label: Clones Spawn
steps.note:
Clones will spawn and dash in the order the nails were killed.
Take note of where the awoken ifrit is, he will have a blue glow.

If you are having trouble understanding this mechanic it may also help to just remember this list, based on which ifrit is awoken:

1st: Short & Fast
2nd: Long & Fast
3rd: Short & Slow
4th: Long & Slow

It is also worth mentioning it is (was?) standard on many DC PF's to kill the nails in a reverse Z formation, which just changes this from counterclockwise to a clockwise pattern.

As of 6.0 it is more standard to skip, so many parties don't even bother with a standard order.

steps.label: Dash #1
steps.note:
Pop Sprint.
Wait for the first dash, and begin moving counterclockwise.

steps.label: Dash #2
steps.note: If Awoken Ifrit was dash #1 or #3, stop here on the intercardinal, otherwise, continue moving counterclockwise.

steps.label: Dash #3
steps.note:
If Awoken Ifrit was dash #1, Crimson Cyclone will appear now.
If Awoken Ifrit was dash #2 or #4, continue counterclockwise.

steps.label: Dash #4-1
steps.note: If Awoken Ifrit was dash #1 or #3, mechanic will resolve here.

steps.label: Dash #4-2
steps.note: If Awoken Ifrit was dash #2 or #4, mechanic will resolve here.

steps.label: Ifrit Targetable
steps.note:
Don't move in too quickly, as there will be one final searing wind on the healer.
MT pull to a wall, away from the healer and party.

steps.label: Tankbuster
steps.note:
Another triple tankbuster, invuln or double tank swap.

Ranged get ready to bait eruptions opposite the tank.

steps.label: Eruptions
steps.note: Party stack for another shared Flaming Crush after eruptions resolve.

steps.label: Flaming Crush + Enrage
steps.note: After Flaming Crush, Ifrit will begin casting enrage.

steps.label: Puddle
steps.note:
Stack along the edge of the arena for phase 3 entry.

If you preposition and grab the puddle as soon as it spawns, you have time to grab it now, otherwise wait until phase 3 begins.

Healer, Caster, or Melee grab it as soon as you can. (Standard is Caster 2nd)
